gate.hint: Fill in this field to continue.

fallback.openManually: Couldn't show this element automatically. Open the matching section in Settings, then continue to the next step.

configure.title: Add an AI provider
configure.desc: Click "Configure" to connect a provider (Claude, OpenAI, Ollama…). At least one is required to enable agents.

enable.title: Enable GitHub
enable.desc: Turn on GitHub sync for this project. The configuration fields will then appear.

token.title: GitHub token
token.desc: Paste a Personal Access Token with the "repo" scope (GitHub ▸ Settings ▸ Developer settings ▸ Tokens).

repo.title: Repository
repo.desc: Enter the repository as owner/repository. Optional at this step.

enable.title: Enable GitLab
enable.desc: Turn on GitLab sync to reveal the configuration fields.

token.title: GitLab token
token.desc: Paste a GitLab personal access token with the "api" scope.

instanceUrl.title: Instance URL
instanceUrl.desc: If you use self-hosted GitLab, enter its URL (otherwise https://gitlab.com). Optional.

project.title: Project
project.desc: Enter the project as group/project. Optional.

enable.title: Enable Azure DevOps
enable.desc: Turn on Azure DevOps sync to reveal the fields.

orgUrl.title: Organization URL
orgUrl.desc: Enter your organization URL, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/your-org.

pat.title: Personal Access Token
pat.desc: Paste an Azure DevOps PAT with Work Items (read/write) and Code permissions.

repository.title: Repository
repository.desc: Pick the repository to use. Optional at this step.

enable.title: Enable Jira
enable.desc: Turn on the Jira integration to reveal the connection fields.

instanceUrl.title: Instance URL
instanceUrl.desc: Enter your instance URL, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net.

email.title: Email
email.desc: Enter the Atlassian account email tied to the API token.

token.title: API token
token.desc: Paste an Atlassian API token (id.atlassian.com ▸ Security ▸ API tokens).

projectKey.title: Project key
projectKey.desc: Enter the Jira project key (e.g. PROJ). Optional.

enable.title: Enable Linear
enable.desc: Turn on Linear sync to reveal the API key field.

apiKey.title: Linear API key
apiKey.desc: Paste a Linear API key (linear.app ▸ Settings ▸ API).

enable.title: Enable memory
enable.desc: Turn on persistent memory (Graphiti) so agents keep context across sessions.

embeddingProvider.title: Embedding provider
embeddingProvider.desc: Choose the embedding provider (local Ollama, OpenAI, Voyage…), then add its key if needed. Optional.

provider.title: CI/CD provider
provider.desc: Choose your pipeline provider (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure, Jenkins) to watch builds.

enable.title: Enable a notification
enable.desc: Turn on a channel (Slack here) to get notified when a PR is ready or a task is done.

webhook.title: Webhook URL
webhook.desc: Paste the Slack incoming webhook URL to receive notifications.
